thesis: The Hawkes point-process family is invalidated by this corpus.
antithesis: Only specific tested instances -- Model 3B-CD V1 (identifiability failure) and the constant-baseline pooled specification (H-05 not evaluable) -- carry a documented negative finding; the general self-exciting point-process class was never exhaustively tested.
evidence_for: Model 3B-CD V1 = VALIDATION_FAILURE (AIC/BIC correct-model-selection 15.6-19.2%% vs >=0.80 gate, REPOSITORY_FACT via MODEL_3B_CD_V1_STATUS_ADDENDUM); constant-baseline pooled Hawkes = INSUFFICIENT (RESEARCHER_DECISION, prior session).
evidence_against: MBPP full closed-form fit (COMPUTED_RESULT, 2026-08-01 session, not re-verified in this operation) reproduced the pooled branching ratio within 0.1%% of the production jittered fit -- a robustness signal for one summary statistic under an independent estimation route; R1/R2 residual diagnostics both TERMINAL without themselves constituting a failure finding.
alternative_explanations: Any apparent failure could trace to baseline misspecification (A2) rather than absence of excitation altogether -- confounded, not yet separable.
unresolved_assumptions: Whether 'Hawkes family' in this claim denotes the general model class or only the specific parameterizations actually fitted.
synthesis: Evidence supports rejecting the two specific tested instances named above; it does not support a general-family failure claim.

thesis: Pooled fit is statistically significant vs a homogeneous-Poisson null (p<0.0001, COMPUTED_RESULT prior session) and therefore validated.
antithesis: Significance against a naive null does not establish model adequacy; H-05 recovery-accuracy criterion is H05_NOT_EVALUABLE_REQUIRES_RESEARCHER_REVIEW and G_V2A_complete=0 (REPOSITORY_FACT, commit f228b4a).
evidence_for: Pooled significance test; five-method convergence noted for the pooled specification only (project_rerun_model_2356_n141 memory).
evidence_against: H-05=NOT_EVALUABLE; V2-A coverage 67.3%%-95.3%% across 12 cells (SOURCE_SUPPORTED_CLAIM, HAWKES_BASELINE_V2A residual validation report); constant-baseline deemed INSUFFICIENT.
alternative_explanations: Significance could arise from A2 (nonstationary baseline), A3/A5 (archival exposure/reporting bursts), A6/A7 (episode fragmentation/duplication), or A8 (date heaping) rather than genuine excitation -- the governing instruction explicitly prohibits AIC_H<AIC_P => historical self-excitation.
unresolved_assumptions: Whether any completed diagnostic in this corpus meets the bar the word 'validated' implies.
synthesis: 'Validated' overclaims; the already-frozen characterization MIXED_VALIDATION_RESULT is the accurate summary.

thesis: Adequate on its own for continued use.
antithesis: Already adjudicated by researcher decision as INSUFFICIENT, with an explicit requirement for a nonstationary or exposure-adjusted comparator before further use.
evidence_against: RESEARCHER_DECISION (prior session, this conversation): 'constant-baseline pooled Hawkes = INSUFFICIENT'.
alternative_explanations: Not applicable -- this is a closed decision layer, not an open mechanism question.
unresolved_assumptions: None -- already adjudicated, not reopened by this operation.
synthesis: Consistent with frozen state; recorded here for completeness of the claim matrix only.

thesis: A nonstationary or exposure-adjusted baseline is required before Hawkes can be meaningfully reconsidered.
antithesis: A more flexible baseline increases parameter count against a modest n=141 sample, which could inflate estimation variance rather than resolve the underlying question.
evidence_for: Corpus spans multiple independently documented regime shifts (1626 pepper monopoly and VOC post withdrawal, 1660 post-1659-peace defection wave, 1682 post-1680-general-alliance wave, 1694 Sas expedition/7 simultaneous Nias treaties, 1755-56 renovation wave) that a constant baseline structurally cannot represent (SOURCE_SUPPORTED_CLAIM, project_markov_hawkes_models memory, cross-checked against project_nias_1693_gap_evidence -- corpus-historical evidence, not a synthetic-DGP analogue); already the subject of an explicit RESEARCHER_DECISION requiring this comparator.
evidence_against: No evidence located against materiality itself, only an estimation-power tradeoff caveat.
alternative_explanations: Not applicable -- this is a baseline-design claim, not a competing mechanism.
unresolved_assumptions: The specific functional form (piecewise-constant by documented era, spline, or exposure-covariate-based) is undetermined -- a PROSPECTIVE_PROPOSAL, not a decision.
synthesis: Materially relevant in direction; specific form remains an open design question for any future comparator build (Section 9, M1/M3). Verified: supporting evidence is corpus-historical (documented regime-shift episodes), not a synthetic-DGP result promoted to historical-mechanism status.

thesis: Bursts in what got recorded/digitized (not in what happened) can generate apparent temporal clustering unrelated to underlying occurrence.
antithesis: Some observed clusters are independently corroborated across multiple distinct primary sources rather than being an artifact of a single source's density, weakening a pure-artifact reading for those specific clusters.
evidence_for: Corpus size itself changed repeatedly across research sessions as new source volumes were incorporated (n=113 to n=141, GM Deel 01-08, CD5/CD6 additions -- REPOSITORY_FACT/SOURCE_SUPPORTED_CLAIM, project_markov_hawkes_models and project_generale_missiven_corpus memory) -- exposure to the archive is demonstrably uneven across calendar research time, a live confound for any within-corpus intensity comparison.
evidence_against: The 1694 peak (Sas expedition, 7 Nias treaties) has cross-source corroboration (project_nias_1693_gap_evidence) suggesting that specific cluster is not purely a recording artifact.
unresolved_assumptions: No formal documentation-density or exposure covariate has yet been constructed for this corpus.
synthesis: Plausible and only partially testable given current artifacts; not ruled in or out.

thesis: A single historical episode split into multiple coded rows would inflate apparent self-excitation without any genuine event-to-event triggering.
antithesis: An existing dedup-adjudication pass (HAWKES_BASELINE_V2_DEDUP_ADJUDICATION.csv, REPOSITORY_FACT) suggests some duplicate/near-duplicate structure was already reviewed upstream of this corpus.
evidence_for: Ontology-readiness gate G_ontology=0 (REPOSITORY_FACT, frozen); PARENT_EPISODE is required as a distinct, currently unmodeled entity (Section 6 of the governing instruction).
evidence_against: No artifact in the repository establishes that the existing dedup pass captures parent-episode structure specifically, as opposed to only exact/near-duplicate individual reports.
alternative_explanations: A6 itself (this row IS the alternative-mechanism entry, cross-referenced in the alternative-mechanism register).
unresolved_assumptions: Whether the dedup-adjudication artifact's scope extends to episode-level fragmentation or stops at report-level duplication.
synthesis: Credible and unresolved; requires ontology work (Section 6, formalized as remediation items R-O3/R-O4 below) before this mechanism can be excluded.

thesis: 48 of 101 (later more, as corpus grew) coded event-years share an identical year-precision date, requiring deterministic jitter before continuous-time MLE; jitter choices can shape apparent kernel decay and peak timing.
antithesis: A jitter-free comparator (MBPP, interval-censored likelihood, fit to the real corpus -- not a synthetic DGP) reproduced the branching ratio within 0.1%% of the jittered production fit, a targeted robustness check against exactly this concern for one summary statistic.
evidence_for: Documented GOTCHA (REPOSITORY_FACT, project_markov_hawkes_models memory) on year-tied dates and required jitter; unconstrained MLE without bounds was shown to degenerate to a pathological delta-spike solution in this corpus, evidencing date-handling sensitivity in principle.
evidence_against: MBPP-full comparison (COMPUTED_RESULT, prior session, not re-verified here) found branching ratio robust to the jitter/date-handling choice specifically.
alternative_explanations: A8 (date heaping and point substitution) -- already the direct subject of this claim.
unresolved_assumptions: The MBPP robustness check covers branching ratio only; kernel shape and individual peak-timing under alternative date treatments have not been separately tested.
synthesis: Partially tested and partially mitigated for one statistic; not closed for the full clustering pattern. Verified: MBPP comparator was fit to the real corpus, not a synthetic analogue, so this evidence is corpus-specific and not subject to the synthetic-to-historical promotion rule.

thesis: Passing residual diagnostics (time-rescaling transform, KS tests) proves the fitted Hawkes model is an adequate description of the data-generating process.
antithesis: R1/R2 are TERMINAL (completed) but are classified as a COMPLETED_REQUIREMENT_NOT_A_BLOCKER for H-05, not as proof of recovery-accuracy adequacy; a standing finding requires residual diagnostics be read only descriptively.
evidence_for: None admissible -- the governing artifact itself forecloses this reading.
evidence_against: HAWKES_BASELINE_V2A_H05_GOVERNANCE_AMENDMENT_PROPOSAL.md (REPOSITORY_FACT, committed f228b4a): residual diagnostics must be reported 'never as a calibrated p-value'; MARGINAL_KS_SAME_SAMPLE_PARAMETER_ESTIMATION_BIAS is a standing finding limiting exactly this inference.
alternative_explanations: Not a mechanism claim -- a statistical-logic caution.
synthesis: Non-rejection is necessary but not sufficient; it does not by itself establish adequacy.

claim_text: Branching ratio has a historical causal interpretation
thesis: eta (fitted offspring ratio) represents the fraction of historical events causally triggered by prior historical events.
antithesis: Explicitly prohibited interpretation under the governing instruction's model layer (Section 5); eta is defined only as an expected fitted-offspring ratio within the specified point-process model for the estimator-input event representation.
evidence_against: G_causal=0 (REPOSITORY_FACT, frozen across every session in this workstream); causal-identification gate requires seven jointly unmet conditions (intervention, counterfactual, confounding, observation, positivity, consistency, identification), none currently satisfied.
unresolved_assumptions: None -- closed by explicit prohibition in the governing instruction.
synthesis: No causal interpretation of eta is permitted at this time, in this corpus.

claim_text: Hawkes may remain useful as an exploratory secondary model
thesis: With strict, procedurally enforced boundaries (no causal or historical-truth claims), Hawkes can still generate hypotheses -- candidate cluster years for closer historical scrutiny -- and the MBPP cross-check shows the fitted offspring-ratio is a technically stable descriptive statistic across two independent estimation routes.
antithesis: Given ontology readiness G_ontology=0 and three open alternative-mechanism claims (C5-C7), any 'exploratory' framing risks sliding into implicit causal or historical-truth framing unless boundaries are enforced procedurally rather than only declared -- and this corpus has a documented history of exactly that slippage. CORRECTION (Checkpoint-1 adjudication): this option is currently superseded by the researcher's F3 decision -- exploratory fitting of any kind is not authorized while F3 is in force.
evidence_for: Prior cluster-year matches (1626, 1660, 1682, 1694, 1756) were independently corroborated against primary sources in separately closed memory workstreams, i.e. exploratory hypothesis-generation value has already been empirically demonstrated here, not merely asserted.
evidence_against: The 2026-08-01 reconciliation session found 3 of 5 follow-up tests weakened a previously-cited stratification claim ('Siklus-exclusive cascade') that had already been cited in downstream documents before being corrected -- direct repository-fact precedent for over-citation risk from this exact model family in this exact corpus.
alternative_explanations: Not applicable -- role-assignment claim, not a mechanism claim.
unresolved_assumptions: What procedural boundary (mandatory disclaimer, required comparator-before-citation rule, review gate) would prevent recurrence of the 2026-08-01 over-citation pattern -- moot while F3 is in force (A_Hawkes_historical_fit=0).
synthesis: Remains an open evidentiary question in principle (evidence is mixed, not disqualifying), but currently NOT authorized for execution: the researcher selected F3 (suspend), which sets A_Hawkes_historical_fit=0 for the current corpus and workstream regardless of this claim's evidentiary status.

claim_text: Hawkes should be retained only as descriptive visualization
thesis: Reduce the role to visualization (intensity curves, annotated cluster years) with zero inferential claim attached.
antithesis: Visualization still displays the same fitted alpha/beta/eta and is subject to the same C5-C7 confounds; a misleading visualization is possible even absent a formal significance claim, so downgrading the label does not by itself resolve the open mechanism questions. A fitted intensity visual can still imply a historical process when N_corpus(t) != H(t) -- descriptive framing is not automatically epistemically safe.
evidence_for: An existing dashboard artifact ([[project_bokeh_dashboard_pemodelan]], REPOSITORY_FACT) already serves this function without a documented overclaiming incident.
evidence_against: None decisive against C11 specifically beyond the general N_corpus(t)!=H(t) reification risk that applies to any display of the fitted intensity; the comparison to C10 is mainly a scope question, not a distinct evidentiary one.
unresolved_assumptions: Whether visualization-only meaningfully reduces overclaiming risk relative to C10's exploratory-secondary-model framing, given both surface the same fitted kernel and branching ratio to a reader.
synthesis: CORRECTED (Checkpoint-1 adjudication): visualization is not epistemically safe by definition merely because it is called descriptive, and remains unsafe as a current role before ontology and observation-model remediation (F3). This is a decision about the current role, not a claim that the underlying model is evidentiarily disproven.
researcher_decision_note: REASON = descriptive visualization remains epistemically unsafe before ontology and observation-model remediation

claim_text: Hawkes should be retired from this corpus entirely
thesis: Cumulative unresolved confounds (C5-C7) plus V2-A's MIXED/NOT_EVALUABLE status justify retiring the whole model family from this corpus.
antithesis: Retirement is the response already and separately applied to Model 3B-CD V1 on the basis of a specific positive falsification (AIC/BIC selection rate 15.6-19.2%% vs an explicit >=0.80 gate); no equivalent falsification exists for the pooled model as a hypothesis-generation tool or for the general Hawkes family. CORRECTION (Checkpoint-1 adjudication): 'NOT_RULED_OUT' is an evidentiary status, not a prohibition on a researcher choosing retirement on cost, epistemic, or design grounds -- retirement remains a legitimate open governance option even though the evidence does not compel it.
evidence_for: None beyond what already justified Model 3B-CD V1's closure specifically.
evidence_against: The frozen scientific state (RESEARCHER_DECISION, prior turn) classifies 'Hawkes family = EXPLORATORY_CANDIDATE, NOT_RULED_OUT' -- this bears on the evidentiary question (whether the family has failed) but does not, by itself, foreclose a researcher governance choice to retire it from this corpus regardless.
unresolved_assumptions: Whether the researcher will treat retirement as warranted on non-evidentiary (cost/design) grounds at a future decision point; not addressed by this operation.
synthesis: CORRECTED (Checkpoint-1 adjudication): retirement was not selected by the researcher this turn (F3 was selected instead), but the option remains open and is not evidentiarily excluded. Do not conflate 'not currently selected' with 'disproven'.
